unit.why: Narrates the tsaddik's vision before his last Passover, in which his late master invited him to preach on parashat Emor in Gan Eden; the hasidim anxiously waited, and he died on Monday of the week of Emor.
unit.boundary_note: story continues into next division (deathbed scene, §צט)

stories.start_quote: והנה נודע ומפורסם אשר פ״א קודם פסח האחרון
stories.end_quote: אשר עליונים נצחו את התחתונים וכו׳
stories.summary_en: Before his last Passover the tsaddik told of a vision in which his late master asked him to preach on parashat Emor in Gan Eden. His followers anxiously waited out Passover and the week of Emor, tsaddikim and hasidim gathered with him, and he died on Monday of that week.
